user_intent: Capture requirements and flows for an OSS native Apple voice/knowledge product with custom iOS keyboard, transcribed outbound calls, composable interfaces/hooks/XDG, local/remote models, self-hosting, retained on-device history and optional iCloud sync. Chain actions through Tuna/Raycast and similar tools on macOS, with equivalent workflow composition on iOS.
methodology: Primary official documentation, help, release notes, App Store and first-party product material.
Public Ghost Pepper OSS source examined at cited revisions; SOURCE-DERIVED is distinct from runtime observation.
Stable source IDs retained in all flow records; source summaries are paraphrases.
Independent per-product research followed by a fresh-reader evidence/requirements review.

Separate version-pinned meeting integration appendix: REA artifact/AST/native evidence, manual inert code reading, LLVM disassembly, official platform docs; complete source preferred for OSS products.
Five additional references selected from sixteen candidates for fit to the brief; current primary documentation and pinned Anarlog/Reflect Open source, without new runtime or binary analysis.
